text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. During a code review, a developer's work is checked by teammates before it is added to the main project. This process is excellent for catching bugs early, as a fresh pair of eyes often spots errors the original writer missed, saving time and money later. Beyond fixing mistakes, reviews promote knowledge sharing; team members learn new techniques and become familiar with different parts of the codebase. Most importantly, they improve overall team quality by encouraging consistent standards and open communication, which builds trust and leads to stronger, more reliable software.
